name: Light My Fire -Hajimemashite-
original_name: LIGHT MY FIRE -はじめまして-
source:
Hero is a teacher during daytime and DJ at night time. Main heroine is the daughter of religious cult guru. Hero acts to prevent destruction activities of this religious cult.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-september-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角白天是教师，晚上是DJ。女主角是宗教邪教教主的女儿。主角采取行动，阻止这个宗教团体的破坏活动。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-september-1998.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
